text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wanting me to take a look, Rice Shower came over wearing her new racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
Dearest Brother, what... do you think?
choice_data_list: It looks really good on you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
Dearest Sister, what... do you think?
choice_data_list: It looks really good on you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you.
Rice really loves it, too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The colors are gentle,
and the design is cute, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I nod in agreement.
It really is a very warm and comforting design.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It evokes a fairy-tale, thrilling kind of world...
Yes, to put it into words—
choice_data_list: Like a chef straight out of a picture book.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: From the picture book...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Dear Brother.
What kind of dishes do you think
the 'Chef from the Picture Book' makes...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Dear Sister.
What kind of dishes do you think
the 'Chef from the Picture Book' makes...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: They all look so delicious...!
choice_data_list: Did you find anything like you imagined?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If it's 'from a picture book,'
it'd definitely be a magical, sparkling, wondrous, and cute dish, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This one's close to what I had in mind, but...
maybe it's a bit too simple.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My gaze falls upon a dish from a distant foreign land.
While it lists unfamiliar ingredients,
easy-to-find substitutes are noted as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following the recipe is one thing, but if we put more thought into the garnish, wouldn't it come closer to the image we want?
choice_data_list: Let's try to give shape to the image inside you, Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
An image, huh...
Creating an original dish might be tough, but
maybe I could manage the plating and garnishing?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Rice wants to try.
Will you help me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rolled up my sleeves to say of course.
Now that that's settled, time to prep.
The important part here is decorating, butâ
choice_data_list: We have to be particular about the tableware too!
How about shaping the ingredients into flowers or birds?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah...!
Let's go find some...
sparkly tableware, Onii-sama!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah...!
Let's go find some...
sparkly tableware, Onee-sama!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I changed into my school uniform and came to look at tableware,
but I can't quite find anything that matches the image in my head.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They're all cute, but...
they don't quite match the image I had in mind.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No... Do I need to come up with something other than tableware?
But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thinking of how happy Rice Shower looked, I couldn't bring myself to suggest compromising. As I wondered what to do—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Dear brother, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Dear sister, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah...!
The glass is glittering in the sunset.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the table were glass
flower vases and accessory trays. They came in various shapes,
including some modeled after shoes and swans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They weren't originally sold as tableware, but their flat bottoms and wide openings served brilliantly as plates.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With boundless, free-spirited creativity,
Rice Shower brought her vision to life.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's so beautiful... surreal, like it isn't even real.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, the sparkling scenery before my eyes is wondrous and beautiful... just like something out of a picture book.
choice_data_list: Since we're here, why not try the real thing?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is it real?
choice_data_list: What kind of picture book do you think this came from?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! Could it be...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Instantly catching on, Rice Shower
started bouncing with joy like a little child.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, mhm. Rice will... give it some thought.
And I'll make sure to draw this food properly too.
If I do that, it'll become real, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll put my heart into drawing it...
so look forward to it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower let her imagination run wild.
I wonder what kind of picture book it will turn out to be.
I'm looking forward to the story about a chef that she'll draw.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah... How lovely!
Could we make it even without candy craft?
Fufu, this is so exciting.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We can make flowers out of carrots and tomatoes, right?
Ah, thin cheese could work too...!
And then, and then... ah.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is there anything else we could use?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Daikon radish... Yeah!
It's not too hard, so it looks like I can carve it into all kinds of shapes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
Thinking about it together is so much fun, Onii-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
Thinking about it together is so much fun, Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A dish crafted with great care over time.
The flowers sculpted with decorative cuts
created a world entirely its own.
choice_data_list: You did that well, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thank you for helping, Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thank you for helping, Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
I had no idea I could make it look this cute...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know... while making it, Rice was wondering:
what kind of feelings did the "picture-book chef" have
when creating this dish?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Decorating must have been tough, but shopping for the supplies and making everything was surely a lot of fun, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: Don't you think she feels the same way Rice does right now?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Right.
Rice is the chef right now...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. In that case, you must've felt
so happy while making it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I hope it brings a smile to their faces.
And that this feeling of happiness... reaches them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gazing at the food upon the table,
the "chef from the picture book"
let out a joyful laugh.
